## 📋 Checklist

Before submitting, ensure:
- [ ] Agent follows the [project structure](../../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#agent-structure)
- [ ] `README.md` is included with documentation
- [ ] `pyproject.toml` has proper dependencies
- [ ] Code is formatted with Black
- [ ] Code passes Ruff linting
- [ ] Agent has been tested manually
- [ ] No sensitive data or API keys in code
